lines.text: The shepherd enters by the gate, calls his own sheep by name, and goes ahead, and they follow.
Jesus says He is the gate, and anyone who enters through Him will be saved.
Jesus says the good shepherd lays down His life, but the hired hand sees the bear coming and runs away.
Jesus says He has other sheep, and He lays down His life to take it up again, willingly.
The Jews are divided, and some say Jesus is demon-possessed, but others ask whether a demon can raise the dead.

wrong_details.true: open the eyes of the blind
